names.note: Nearest named place in a 10 km expanded search area; not official neighborhood boundaries.

sanity.note: Fractional uniform block-group estimates; boundary vintages differ. Wake and Durham counties included.

censusTransport.reason: Census API requires a key; bulk files provide the same estimates without authentication.

p2.allocation: BG counts / all centroid-contained H3 cells in the complete BG; then retain study-area centers. Six decimal places.
limitations: Uniform spatial allocation is not observed household geography.
Wake and Durham County ACS estimates are included; missing coverage is explicitly listed.
Age, poverty and no-car measures overlap; noCarHH counts households, not people.
Nearest OSM place names are labels, not authoritative neighborhood boundaries.
ACS margins of error are not modeled by the Cell contract.

methods.graph: OSMnx simplified directed drive graph; retain all components; posted speeds with road-class fallbacks in km/h; free-flow seconds.
methods.routingExtent: Study area plus 5 km to include nearby hospitals and avoid hard study-boundary truncation.
methods.hazards: FEMA Wake/Durham DFIRM IDs, ID-complete download; unsimplified dissolved polygons classify cells/edges/site footprints. Display geometry clipped to study area and simplified 10 m.
methods.cutOff: Cells whose nearest graph node cannot reach a hospital at step 3. Includes pre-existing dry gaps; their indices are separately reported.
methods.coverage: Cell-to-site travel along directed roads, 900-second threshold; raw routing coverage retained even for flooded sites (engine checks site floodStep).
methods.siteSelection: One per H3 resolution 8; schools, community centres, libraries, worship in that order. Retain first candidates fitting 5 MB.
methods.roadProtection: Connected, unbranched flooded chains per street; reopen all member directed edges with all other flooded roads closed; rank pop+pop65+lowInc+2.5*noCarHH of newly accessible cells.
methods.dots: 120 m metric grid inside exported flood geometry; earliest matching step.

limitations: Flood zones are scenario stages, not a time/depth hydraulic model.
Bridges close on 2D intersection regardless of deck elevation; traffic, capacity and turn restrictions are not modeled.
Nearest-node snapping omits driveway/access connectors; snap distances are audited.
OSM hospital tagging does not guarantee an emergency department, opening hours, or storm operation.
NFHL coverage is limited to Wake and Durham; roads beyond those counties in the routing margin have no modeled flood closures.
Heat and canopy fields remain zero placeholders for P10.
